notes.title: Future of our game
notes.notes:
Hello, future players of Medieval Contrast! You are probably eagerly awaiting news from us regarding development, game mechanics and, of course, regarding the release date - we answer many of these questions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535113/173e6afcb19aacaf647d26ab3196d12070ffb88a.png[/img]

At the moment, the development is at the stage of final prototyping of mechanics, while we try to combine prototyping and finalization of finished mechanics with implementation in the main build of the game in order to speed up the development process.

We do not want to make a copy of the games you are already familiar with with a new visual component, but want to create a completely different game in which you will enjoy spending time.

[b]A little about the game[/b]

Our game will not intentionally drag out the gameplay for the sake of increased time in the game, on the contrary, we want to make the sequence of game progress a little easier, while leaving a gap for increasing the amount of content, so that you spend time in our game not because of complications in obtaining any resources, opening skills, etc., but due to the interest in the content that our game provides.

Along with the above, we will not intentionally make the first 2 hours of the game more interesting than others, but will present to your attention from the early stages of the game what it is, demonstrating game mechanics and features. From the first steps, you will be able to determine whether you are interested in playing our game or not.

[b]What due to game mechanics[/b]

For obvious reasons, we cannot tell you in as much detail as possible about the game mechanics that await you in Medieval Contrast, but we can give you some food for thought.

We decided to abandon the armor equipment system so as not to greatly affect the appearance of the main character, preserving his identity in the game world, while a fairly extensive skill system will help to interestingly cover all the necessary needs associated with character protection.

Our team does not focus on similar game projects, so at first the game may seem unusual to you and, on the contrary, open up later.

The realism of the game world contributes to the resulting game mechanics. You can get wet after the rain and get sick if you do not find a place to warm up in time, or be left without food for the winter if you do not take care of this in advance, since lakes and rivers will simply freeze, and animals will try to avoid you, some will disappear from the radar altogether, as they will hide in their "homes".

[b]If you do not compare yourself with other projects, what should we expect?[/b]

This question sounds quite logical and we will be happy to answer it. You will not only have to found your own dynasty and build the first huts, but also set the rhythm for your dynasty, since you are its heart and key link. The fate of the inhabitants who have joined you will depend on your decisions.

In addition to your settlement, the game will have several major points of interest: enemy bases, outposts, peaceful settlements, a trading port with a market, and much more. You will constantly be forced to explore the game world, but doing so with pleasure and interest, not knowing where the next turn in a different direction will lead you.

[b]When will the game be released?[/b]

Initially, we planned the release date for December 2025, but we want to create a truly unimaginable game, which is very difficult on the scale of an indie studio. In this regard, at the moment, we think that the first stage of our game will be early access, during which we will be able to bring the game to a result close to ideal, adding new content on a regular basis.

The planned starting price for early access is $10-14, but in some regions the price may differ slightly in one direction or another. In the first week of release, the price of the game will be promotional, namely with a 20% discount.

[b]Will there be an open beta testing and demo?[/b]

Open beta testing is not planned, since it was decided to start with early access. The duration of early access is preliminarily estimated at 6-12 months, after which the price of the game will be increased.

We do not plan to launch a demo version of the game yet, but we do not rule it out in the future.

notes.title: DevDays #2 | Companion
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear players! The days of development are not in vain - we work every day so that the result of our work pleases and surprises you in the best sense of the word.

This time we want to share with you a little insider information about the horses in our game.

[h3]Let's talk about horses[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535113/8fb8a35bbe607b71f58c3dee88d3c2bd77e212b1.png[/img]

We have added highly detailed horse models to our game.

Horses are your real companions. Throughout the gameplay, they will help you move around the game world.

The horse itself can be purchased in a special location for in-game currency. You will be able to independently choose the horse that suits you by its coloring, since each horse is visually unique in its own way.

You can call a horse at any time by pressing the appropriate key and get to the place you need.

In addition to moving, you will be able to put a special saddle on your horse with a small bag, where you can put a few additional items that did not fit in your inventory.

notes.title: DevDays #1 | Season's Changes
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! We have some great news for you that will make your gaming life even more exciting! In our game, we are proud to present a realistic seasonal system that has been carefully designed to make each season feel real!

[h3]What have we done?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535113/d5ede91b8a8e9c3d86167494deff245607eea00c.png[/img]
Imagine yourself waking up every morning in the game and the weather outside changing just as dynamically as in real life. With the arrival of winter, you will see the first snow gently falling on the ground, creating a magical atmosphere. With each new day, it will gradually accumulate, covering the landscape with a snow-white sheet. And what about spring? Flowers begin to bloom, birds return, and the world around is filled with the sounds of life!

🍁 Autumn will bring with it bright, saturated color palettes. Rains, the monotonous noise of which will become your most pleasant accompaniment, will add realism and immersion in the atmosphere!

But that's not all! For those who enjoy active recreation, we are working on leisure activities – 🦌 hunting adventures and fishing! Seasons will affect the behavior of animals, opening up new opportunities for hunting and fishing for you. Immerse yourself in exciting gameplay moments when you track game among snowy expanses or fish in one of the calm lakes in spring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535113/8ce5dbcfc82abb5b496f495fea4d78346e6d5b86.png[/img]
We are confident that these elements will make the game truly unique and exciting. We are making every effort to create a world in which you can enjoy every moment and every seasonal change!

Stay with us, because there is still a lot of interesting things ahead! 💬 Don't forget to share your thoughts in the comments and stay tuned for further updates!

Together we will create an unforgettable gaming atmosphere! Thank you for your support! 🎮❤️
